facts.rationale: Corrects the unsupported relationship-unregistration interpretation while preserving item-side flow and caller-owned lifetime management.
facts.value: Reads the item's model bone_attach_id and retained grab_victim fighter, removes the attachment, and samples that fighter's SpecialN bone into item->pos. It calls it_8027B4A4 and it_8027B378 with the fighter and item, passing zero to the latter; these helpers conditionally forward fighter metadata to player-reporting routines rather than unregistering relationships. It optionally resets destroy_type to zero, clears atk_victim and grab_victim, then calls it_8027CE44 and Item_8026A8EC. Ordinary SpecialN script cleanup passes false; general fighter cleanup selects the Boolean from four named SpecialN states. Both callers clear the fighter-side target pointers after the call.

facts.rationale: Replaces the incorrect claim that the two common helpers unregister the item from its fighter.
facts.value: Performs terminal cleanup of the item attached during Yoshi's SpecialN item-target interaction: removes its bone attachment, samples the retained fighter's SpecialN bone position, performs conditional player reporting through common helpers, optionally clears destroy_type, clears the item's retained fighter references, and invokes final item cleanup and destruction. Fighter-side target_item_gobj and x1A64 clearing is performed by callers, not by the reporting helpers.
